name: Dumbbell Triceps Kickback
summary: A bent-over triceps isolation exercise where you straighten the elbow behind you. It needs only light dumbbells and trains the triceps at full contraction.
setup: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, or one dumbbell while supporting yourself with the other hand on a chair or sofa.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back until the torso is about 45 degrees, knees soft.
Bring your upper arms alongside your torso, parallel to the floor, with elbows bent to 90 degrees.
execution: Keeping your upper arm still, extend your elbow until your arm is straight behind you.
Squeeze your triceps for a moment at the end.
Keep your torso still the whole time.
cues: Upper arm glued to the torso
mistakes: Swinging the weight: use a lighter dumbbell and move only at the elbow.
Dropping the elbow: keep the upper arm in line with your back.
Rounding the back: keep a flat back and hinge at the hips, or support yourself on a chair.
Stopping short of full extension: finish each rep with a straight arm.
